title: Super-resolved 3D Tracking of Cargo Transport Through Nuclear Pore Complexes by Astigmatism Imaging
protocol: Inoculate BL21(DE3) cells transfected with pQE32-Ran into 5 mL of LB with 2% glucose + Amp, and culture overnight at 37°C.
Transfer the starter culture to 1 L of LB with 2% glucose + Amp, and grow until an OD600 of ~0.8 is reached.
Induce with 1 mM IPTG and grow for another 4 h at 27°C.
Centrifuge the culture (4,000 x g, 20 min, 4°C).
Inoculate BL21(DE3) cells transfected with pET15b-NTF2 into 5 mL of LB + Amp, and culture overnight at 37°C.
Transfer the starter culture to 2 L of LB + Amp the following day.
Grow the culture at 37°C until an OD600 of ~0.8 is reached.
Induce cells with 1 mM IPTG.
Grow induced cells for 4 hours at 27°C.
Centrifuge the culture at 4,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 20 mL of lysis buffer (20 mM Tris, 200 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl₂, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.0 + PI).
Lysate cells by passing through a French press three times at 16,000 psi.
Centrifuge the lysate at 15,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Precipitate NTF2 from the cleared lysate with saturated ammonium sulfate (at ~40-50% saturation).
Recover precipitated NTF2 by centrifugation at 4,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Dissolve the pellet in 5 mL of 50 mM Tris buffer, pH 8.
Purify the NTF2 solution using an HiPrep Q FF Anion Exchange Resin column with a linear NaCl gradient.
Further purify the NTF2 solution by Superdex 75 size exclusion chromatography.
Inoculate BL21(DE3) cells transfected with pRSET-hSRP⍺ into 5 mL of LB + Amp.
Culture overnight at 30°C.
Transfer starter culture to 2 L of LB + Amp and grow until an OD₆₀₀ of ~0.8 is reached.
Induce the culture with 0.8 mM IPTG and grow for another 4.5 hours at 28°C.
Centrifuge the induced culture at 4,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 10 mL of buffer containing 20 mM Tris, 200 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgSO₄, 10 mM imidazole, and 4 mM βME at pH 8.0.
Lysate the cell suspension using a French press three times at 16,000 psi.
Centrifuge the lysed sample at 15,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Mix the supernatant with 0.6 mL of Ni-NTA resin and incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Transfer the suspension containing Ni-NTA resin to a gravity column.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 20 mL of buffer containing 20 mM Tris, 1 M NaCl, 5 mM MgSO₄, 10 mM imidazole, 4 mM βME, and 0.1% TX-100 at pH 8.0.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with an additional 20 mL of buffer containing 20 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, and 10 mM imidazole at pH 8.
Elute the protein from the Ni-NTA resin using 20 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, and 250 mM imidazole at pH 8.0 by collecting fractions of 0.5 mL each.
Purify the most concentrated fraction through Superdex 200 size exclusion chromatography using a buffer containing 20 mM HEPES and 150 mM NaCl at pH 7.3.
Inoculate BL21(DE3) cells transfected with pQE9-Imp β into 5 mL of LB medium supplemented with 2% glucose and ampicillin, then culture overnight at 37°C.
Transfer the starter culture to 1 L of LB medium containing 2% glucose and ampicillin and grow until an OD₆₀₀ of approximately 0.8 is reached.
Induce expression by adding 0.7 mM IPTG and continue growing for another 3 hours at 37°C.
Centrifuge the induced culture at 4,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in 6 mL of 5 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgSO4, 10 mM imidazole, 4 mM βME, pH 8.0 + PI.
Lysate by French press (3X at 16,000 psi).
Centrifuge the lysate (15,000 x g, 20 min, 4°C).
Mix the supernatant with 0.5 mL Ni-NTA resin.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Transfer the suspension to a gravity column.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 5 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgSO4, 10 mM imidazole, 4 mM βME, 0.1% TX-100, pH 8.0 + PI (20 mL).
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 5 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8 (20 mL).
Elute with 5 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, 250 mM imidazole, pH 8.0 collecting 0.5 mL fractions.
Purify the most concentrated fraction by Superdex 200 size exclusion chromatography using 20 mM HEPES, 110 mM KOAc, 5 mM NaOAc, 2 mM MgOAc2, 2 mM DTT, pH 7.3 (import buffer without EGTA; IBnoEGTA).
Inoculate BL21-Gold(DE3) cells transfected with pGEX4TT3-TEV-KapBeta2 into 20 mL of LB with 2% glucose + Amp.
Culture overnight at 37°C.
Transfer the starter culture to 2 L of LB with 2% glucose + Amp.
Grow at 25°C until an OD600 of ~0.6 is reached.
Induce with 0.5 mM IPTG and grow for another 12 h at 25°C.
Centrifuge the culture at 4,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 30 mL of 50 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 15% glycerol, 2 mM DTT, 2 mM EDTA, pH 7.4 + PI.
Lysate the resuspended cells by French press three times at 16,000 psi.
Centrifuge the lysate at 15,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Mix the supernatant with 0.5 mL glutathione Sepharose resin and incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the suspension to a gravity column.
Wash the glutathione Sepharose resin with 25 mL of 50 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EGTA, 10 mM MgOAc₂, 2 mM DTT, 15% glycerol, 5 mM ATP, pH 7.4 + PI.
Wash the glutathione Sepharose resin with 20 mL of 20 mM HEPES, 20 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA, 10% glycerol, 2 mM DTT, pH 7.4.
Incubate the Sepharose resin with 1 mL of 20 mM HEPES, 20 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA, 10% glycerol, 2 mM DTT, 0.5 units/µL TEV protease, pH 7.4 for 2 hours at room temperature.
Elute the protein with the same buffer (0.5 mL fractions).
Purify the most concentrated fraction by Enrich Sec 650 size exclusion chromatography using IBnoEGTA.
Inoculate BL21(DE3) cells transfected with pET30a-M9-βGal-8C into 4 mL of LB + Kan and culture overnight at 37°C.
Transfer the starter culture to 1 L of LB + Kan.
Grow at 37°C until an OD600 of ~0.8 is reached.
Induce with 0.15 mM IPTG and grow overnight at 22°C.
Centrifuge the culture (4,000 x g, 20 min, 4°C).
Resuspend the cells in 6 mL of 5 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgSO4, 10 mM imidazole, 4 mM βME, pH 8.0 + PI.
Lyse by French press (3X at 16,000 psi).
Centrifuge the lysate (15,000 x g, 20 min, 4°C).
Mix the supernatant with 0.5 mL Ni-NTA resin.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Transfer the suspension to a gravity column.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 15 mL of 5 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 4 mM βME, 0.1% TX-100, pH 8.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 15 mL of 5 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.
Elute with 5 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, 250 mM imidazole, pH 8 collecting 0.5 mL fractions.
Purify the most concentrated fraction by Enrich Sec 650 size exclusion chromatography using 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.3.
Inoculate JM109 cells transfected with pNLS-2xBFP(4C) into 5 mL of LB + Amp.
Culture overnight at 37°C.
Transfer the starter culture to 1 L of LB + Amp.
Grow at 37°C until an OD600 of ~0.8 is reached.
Induce bacterial culture with 0.7 mM IPTG.
Grow induced culture for 14 hours at 25°C.
Centrifuge the culture at 4,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 6 mL of buffer containing 5 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgSO₄, 10 mM imidazole, and 4 mM βME, pH 8.0 + PI.
Lysate the resuspended cells by passing through a French press three times at 16,000 psi.
Centrifuge the lysate at 15,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Mix the supernatant with 0.5 mL Ni-NTA resin and incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the suspension to a gravity column.
Wash Ni-NTA resin with 20 mL of buffer containing 5 mM Tris, 500 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgSO₄, 10 mM imidazole, 4 mM βME, and 0.1% TX-100, pH 8.0 + PI.
Wash Ni-NTA resin with an additional 20 mL of buffer containing 5 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, and 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.0.
Elute bound proteins using 5 mM Tris, 100 mM NaCl, and 250 mM imidazole, pH 8.0, collecting fractions in 0.5 mL volumes.
Purify the most concentrated fraction by Superdex 200 size exclusion chromatography using IBnoEGTA.
Inoculate BL21(DE3) cells transfected with pLaG-9(S151C) into 5 mL of LB + Amp.
Culture overnight at 37°C in a starter culture.
Transfer the starter culture to 1 L of LB + Amp and grow until an OD₆₀₀ of ~0.8 is reached.
Induce bacterial culture with 0.1 mM IPTG.
Grow induced culture for 20 hours at 20°C.
Centrifuge the culture at 4,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 10 mL ice cold buffer containing 20 mM Tris, 0.5 mM EDTA, 500 mM sucrose, 10 mM βME, and 0.3 mM MgSO4, pH 8.0 + PI.
Lysate by French press (3X at 16,000 psi).
Centrifuge the lysate at 15,000 x g for 20 min at 4°C.
Mix the supernatant with 0.5 mL Ni-NTA resin and incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Transfer the suspension to a gravity column.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 15 mL of buffer containing 20 mM Tris, 900 mM NaCl, 10 mM βME, and 0.1% TX-100, pH 8.0.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin again with 15 mL of buffer containing 20 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 8.0.
Elute with 20 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, and 250 mM imidazole, pH 8.0, collecting 0.5 mL fractions.
Purify the most concentrated fraction by Superdex 75 size exclusion chromatography using buffer containing 20 mM HEPES and 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.3.
Incubate the dye-protein mixture with 0.1 mL Ni-NTA resin for 30 min.
Wash the resin-bound protein with 20 mL of 20 mM HEPES, 500 mM NaCl, 0.1% TX-100, 4 mM BME, pH 7.3.
Wash with 10 mL of 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.3 to remove the detergent.
Elute the labeled nanobody with 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 250 mM imidazole, pH 7.3 collecting 50 μL fractions.
Grow cells to approximately 95% confluency for culture maintenance.
Split cells using Accutase for culture maintenance.
Test cells monthly for mycoplasma contamination.
Split cells the night before microscopy experiments.
Dilute cells to less than 3% confluency onto coverslips pre-treated with 0.01% poly-L-lysine for 5 min.
Treat coverslips with 0.01% poly-L-lysine for 5 minutes.
Use U-2 OS-CRISPR-NUP96-mEGFP cells for experiments.
Form a slide containing immobilized fluorescent microspheres.
Add 150 μL of a mixture of 1 µm and 0.1 µm Tetraspeck microspheres diluted into autoclaved distilled water to each chamber.
Add 200 μL of preheated and cleared 2% agarose solution in autoclaved water to each chamber.
Allow the agarose solution to cool and solidify in each chamber.
Permeabilize the cells by incubating with 40 µg/mL digitonin in import buffer (IB) for 2 min.
Wash permeabilized cells once with 10 µL IB + 1.2% (w/v) PVP.
Add 10 µL of 100 nM LaG-9(S151C-HMSiR) in IB-PVP to the permeabilized cells.
Incubate for 3 min.
Wash the cells twice with 10 µL IB-PVP.
When ready, the transport mix (~10 µL) is flowed into the desired chamber with the nanobody-decorated NPCs.
Allow the sample to stabilize and the RanGTP/RanGDP gradient to be established across the nuclear envelope for ~1 min.
Acquire images for NPC localizations (red channel, ~8 min total time).
Acquire images for cargo translocation (green channel, ~2 min total time).
Image sequences necessary for z-calibration curves should be obtained immediately after acquiring cargo transport and NPC localization data.
Obtain z-stack image sequences of a bead near the origin (center of the frame) for both green and red channels.
Image at least five different 0.1 μm beads embedded in 2% agarose for both green and red channels to obtain calibration curves.
Acquire images necessary to calculate an image alignment matrix using the same method as for z-calibration curves.
Ensure that each experiment has different optimized DM settings for calibrations.
Use small beads bright enough to take a long time to photobleach, which yield diffraction-limited spots approximating those of fluorescent protein particles.
Determine the x, y, and z coordinates of single particle spots in image sequences using Fiji with the ThunderSTORM plug-in.
Obtain a z-calibration curve from z-stack images of 0.1 μm beads after nuclear import data collection.
Fit the distribution of differences in spot widths along x and y as a function of z to yield a z-calibration curve.
Open the calibration z-stack image sequence in Fiji.
Under the ‘Thunder STORM’ plugin, click on ‘3D calibration’.
Set parameters as specified and click ‘OK’.
Save the calibration file.
Open the image sequence to analyze in Fiji.
Under the ‘Thunder STORM’ plugin, click on ‘Run analysis’.
Set parameters as specified and click ‘OK’.
In the ‘ThunderSTORM:results’ output window, run the “remove duplicates” script.
Eliminate localizations that are too close using a threshold of 5 nm.
For NPC scaffold data, run the “density filters” script to eliminate those in low density areas.
Calculate the x, y, and z coordinates of 0.1 µm beads in 100 frame image sequences collected at different z positions using ThunderSTORM.
Determine the standard deviation of the position measurements for the x, y, and z coordinates.
Plot the x, y, and z precisions as a function of z position.
Obtain the mean x and y coordinates of the 0.1 µm beads in the 100-frame images sequences recorded earlier for both color channels using ThunderSTORM.
Obtain the xy alignment matrix to transform x and y green channel coordinates into red channel coordinates.
Use a non-linear least-squares fitting routine to determine angular and translational corrections.
Calculate the standard deviation of differences between transformed green channel coordinates and measured red channel coordinates.
Define this standard deviation as the alignment precision in x and y.
Determine z-focus rough alignment using adaptive optics for two imaging channels.
Estimate distance between distinct z-calibration curves for the two color channels.
Calculate the average difference in the mean z-position for 0.1 µm beads in 100-frame image sequences recorded earlier for both color channels.
Calculate the standard deviation of the difference in mean z-position between the two channels.
Run "photonandz_filter" to filter out localizations with z = 0±300 nm and photon count ≥ 3000.
Use "circular_roi" to select clusters of at least 10 localizations within a circular xy diameter of 60-150 nm.
Extract the coordinates and photon counts of individual clusters into separate text files using "separate_pores".
Fit the localizations in each cluster to a double circle model using "estimate_cylinder", yielding centroid (x, y, z), diameter of circles, and distance between circles.
Run "select_pores" to identify clusters with at least 10 points, a diameter of 80-135 nm, height of 40-65 nm, and a z-center of 0±200 nm.
Run "circlefit_bisquare" script.
Fit cluster localizations to a circle in the xy-plane.
Calculate mean xy distance to the circle for all localizations (residuals).
Determine standard deviation of residuals.
Eliminate localizations whose residual is more than two standard deviations from the mean.
Re-run “estimate_cylinder” and “select_pores” scripts if points are eliminated.
Translate cluster localizations in x, y, and z to the origin (0, 0, 0).
Align centroids determined from double circle fit.
Rotate individual NPC data by a phase angle before aligning all clusters.
Identify the quadrant for the angle of each localization.
Subtract 45° from the angles > 45°.
Generate the angle distribution histogram (0-45º) with a bin of 5º.
Estimate the phase angle using a sinusoidal function fit.
Translate the center (centroid) of each cluster to the origin.
Rotate every point in a cluster about its centroid by the estimated phase angle.
Merge the rotated clusters.
Curate the dataset with "photon_based_filter".
Retain only localizations with ≥ 1000 photons.
Transform x, y, z coordinates into red channel coordinates using "green_localization_in_red_channel" and the previously calculated image alignment matrix.
Identify cargo localizations within a 400 nm cube centered on an NPC centroid using "track_localize_whole_roi".
Align cargo localizations into the averaged NPC scaffold via xyz translation.
Rotate cargo localizations based on their proximity to pores in the 400 nm cube using "centering_tracks_wrt_whole" and "track_rotation_in_whole".
Analyze aligned cargo complex localizations with the averaged NPC scaffold.
Assume cargo localizations in multiple successive frames associated with the same NPC represent the same molecule.
Define trajectories as three or more consecutive localizations.
Categorize trajectories manually based on initial and eventual compartments to define import, abortive import, export, and abortive export.
